notes.title: Alien Attack v1.4 update
notes.content:
Unexpected update is here!

Added:
[list]
[*] [b]New palettes selection system:[/b] now you can buy palettes which you want the most, using points. The palette shop is in the main menu, below the "START" button.
[*] [b]New skin[/b] [i]([spoiler]unlocked after getting "Palette Lover!" achievement[/spoiler])[/i].
[*] [b]Updated achievements' images:[/b] the game's visual style has changed since 2016, so there are new images.
[*] [b]Smooth menus' navigations:[/b] it looks a lot cooler when they're smooth... right?
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

Have fun!

And don't forget to post bugs [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/391310/discussions/]here[/url] if you find some.

notes.title: Alien Attack: Zero fix
notes.content:
Looks like it was not working properly if your Steam interface is not English or Russian. It means if you have Japanese interface for example, the game would crash and display a message with some mysterious "kekpek" variable.

Now it should work properly. If something goes wrong, don't be afraid to write in the discussion thread [i](link sadly removed)[/i]. Really, don't be afraid! I subscribed to it and I'll get a notification everytime someone writes a message there.

UPD: O'k the topic is gone. Here's the other one: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/391310/discussions/0/152392786908151951/] click[/url].

notes.title: Black screen with game responding
notes.content:
This issue caused by Windows 10 Creators update (April 2017).
Known ways to get the game working:
— Turning on Windows 8 compatibility mode
— Removing this update
— Alt+Enter (playing in window mode) 
Hope MS will fix it as soon as possible. 
... ːavgnmadː

notes.title: "FATAL ERROR in Vertex Shader ..." fix
notes.content:
Hi there!
We have noticed [i](not for everyone)[/i] that the game shows up an error about [i]"Vertex Shader bla bla bla"[/i] on launch. The reason is that you have no DirectX runtime installed. We've added it to default installation redists. But if you have an error appearing again and again, you can install the runtime from here:
[url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?displaylang=en&id=35]DirectX End-User Runtime Web Installer
[/url]
Hope it will work for you!
